description: Claude Code only (the skill dispatches parallel tasks that load the assess-team-dimension skill and defers its scoring scale to skill://assessment-report-suite, so it is not a self-contained single SKILL.md for Pi). A plain-language request for a team assessment of a small seeded Node repository (tallyboard) with the final report at docs/assessment/team-2026-03-02.md and REPORT_PREFIX `fixture`. The sandbox git history is a single fixture commit, so no git-derived signal (authorship, trends, merges, blame) is exercised; the planted facts live in files: CONTRIBUTORS.md (fake people, two with fewer than 10 commits, the privacy trap), five source files of which three carry a `Generated by` or `AI-Generated` marker, six TODO/FIXME comments, two test scripts (tests/*-check.js) covering only orders and util (the payments service is untested), and four services of which only orders has a README. Deterministic checks cover: the report is saved with the skill's title; its sections appear in order; the six dimension files exist, each with a valid `Score: <1.0-5.0> / <Letter>`; the Overall Scores table has exactly the seven rows with letters derived from the shared scale and no incident, volume or per-developer row; the Code Review score is capped at 2.0 and says peer review cannot be verified from local git; the Data Limitations section names the API-only data and says incident response is not assessed; no contributor name or email and no per-author table appear; the commit-messages analysis admits the one-commit history; the untested payments service, the services without a README, the AI-marker count and the TODO/FIXME count are found; and nothing is written outside docs/assessment/. Limits: structure and planted-fact checks only; they do not show the analysis is insightful or that scores are deserved, and the git-history, blame, merge and PR-review paths are not tested. The baseline arm gets the same prompt without the plugin and is expected to produce a team report too, so the uplift measures the plugin's conventions (the six dimension files, numeric/letter scoring, the review cap, the privacy guard), not general ability.
prompt:
Run a team assessment of this repository: commit messages, code quality, test coverage, AI adoption, documentation and code review, using six parallel specialist analyses. Use REPORT_PREFIX `fixture`, save each dimension's findings under docs/assessment/ and the final report to docs/assessment/team-2026-03-02.md (date 2026-03-02).

This is a non-interactive run: ask no questions. Write only files under docs/assessment/; do not change any other file.
